name: Unequal
note: Unequal's Unequal ruleset. Adjacent replaces the clue kind, so it is another game of the family (adjacent.json).

done.note: a play aid with no meaning for the answer

greater.note: v is the end at the open side of the sign

deal.clues: which true inequalities show, fewer at higher tiers

techniques.note: One sign, both its ends: the larger end is larger than the smaller end's least candidate, and the smaller end smaller than the larger end's greatest.
techniques.for: k in clues(greater), big = v(k), small = lesser(k)
techniques.conclude: (forall d in cand(big) where forall d2 in cand(small): d <= d2: strike(big, d)) and (forall d in cand(small) where forall d2 in cand(big): d >= d2: strike(small, d))
